claims.claim: automatic gearbox and manual gearbox for Toyota Corolla, Carry, Hilux
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a used engine/gearbox assembly on the ground, but no readable make/model, no Toyota branding/part numbers, and no clear transmission type (manual vs automatic) from the provided angles.
No documentation, labels, shipping marks, or import evidence shown in the witness report.
Photos show grime/rust and dismantled assembly; no test results, video of running, diagnostic printout, or fault-code scan is shown.
No running video/audio or mechanic test report is included in the witness observations.
No odometer/ECU mileage readout or service record is shown.
Photos do not show tamper evidence clearly (e.g., seals, opened covers, or inspection marks), and the assembly appears dismantled/used.

risks.risk: Transmission type may not match what you need (manual vs automatic) and may not be compatible with the target vehicle/ECU/TCU.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number) and a shot showing the transmission type markings, plus the engine code/plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used, dismantled engine/gearbox assembly with unknown compatibility and unknown transmission type.

risks.risk: Unknown engine type and engine code (petrol/diesel, variant) affecting fitment and performance.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and any stamped markings on the block, plus a photo showing fuel system type (e.g., diesel pump/injector layout vs petrol components).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified engine/gearbox unit with unknown engine variant.

risks.risk: Completeness risk: missing accessories/sensors/mounts/hoses/connectors could make it unusable or require extra parts.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip laid out: starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, all connectors, hoses, brackets, and any ECU/TCU (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness, assuming you may need to source missing parts.

risks.risk: Internal condition risk (crank/bearings/seals/clutch/flywheel health) not assessable from external grime.
risks.proof: Compression test results and/or leak-down test, plus a video of a cold start and idle (or diagnostic scan showing no stored faults).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as potentially needing overhaul (seals/bearings/clutch) due to unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: Wiring harness/connector integrity risk: connectors may be damaged, mismatched, or missing, causing electrical faults.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of each connector end (showing pin condition) and a continuity/diagnostic scan report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical/connector condition unknown; assume rework or replacement may be required.

risks.risk: Mounting points/casing cracks/leaks risk: rust/grime may hide cracks or oil seepage.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of all mounting ears, bell-housing seams, and any suspected leak points, plus a pressure/vacuum test or leak check report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible leaks/cracks until proven otherwise.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the gearbox and engine identification plates (part numbers) and engine code.
Photos showing whether the gearbox is manual or automatic (type markings/label) and the relevant bell-housing/gearbox features.
A video of the unit being started/running (or a diagnostic scan report with fault codes cleared and current live data).
Compression test (and/or leak-down) results for the engine.
A completeness checklist with photos of all included parts: starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, hoses, ECU/TCU (if applicable), and all connectors.
Close-up photos of mounting points and bell-housing seams to check for cracks and oil seepage.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used, dismantled engine/gearbox assembly, but key details needed to price it safely in Abuja (exact engine/gearbox type, compatibility, completeness, and proof of working condition) are not shown. Without those proofs, any price would be guesswork.
